title: Cartwise+ Membership Shopper Offer for Recent Grocery Spending
content:
A shopper offer is taken off the charge when a Cartwise+ Membership member moves up from a monthly plan to Cartwise+ Annual, following the item charges on the member's Cartwise Grocery Orders over the last three months.

**Scale.** At least 150.00 takes 3.00 off; at least 75.00 and less than 150.00 takes 1.50 off; less takes 0.00 off.

| Item charges on the member's Cartwise Grocery Orders in the last three months (USD) | Offer taken off (USD) |
|---|---|
| 150.00 or more | 3.00 |
| 75.00 to 149.99 | 1.50 |
| below 75.00 | 0.00 |

## What is totalled

The item-charge entries of the member's Cartwise Grocery Orders dated in the last three months, by amount. The window is counted in whole months ending today; an entry dated on the same day of the month three months back is not counted — with today 20 April, entries dated 21 January through 20 April count.

## Hypothetical boundary cases

| Item charges in the window | Offer |
|---|---|
| 150.00 | 3.00 |
| 149.99 | 1.50 |
| 75.00 | 1.50 |
| 74.99 | 0.00 |
